name: mitii-ai-agent
description: Local-first VS Code AI coding agent with repository-aware context and controlled execution

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Mitii can open its UI in Restricted Mode, but repository indexing, agent execution, shell tools, and file mutations require a trusted workspace.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Mitii requires a file-system workspace for repository indexing, SQLite-backed code/text indexes, audit artifacts, and controlled file mutations.

mitii.developer.enabled.description: Unlock developer options in the Mitii Settings → Developer page (nested debug switches appear after this is enabled)

mitii.debug.description: Enable debug logging in the Mitii Output channel (auto-shows the channel; includes stack traces on failures). Requires mitii.developer.enabled in Settings → Developer.

mitii.tokenBudget.enabled.description: Use custom Window Budget ratios from mitii.tokenBudget.* instead of built-in defaults. Requires developer settings in the Mitii Debug tab.

mitii.tokenBudget.outputRatio.description: Fraction of the context window reserved for model output when max output is 0.

mitii.tokenBudget.outputMinTokens.description: Floor for the derived output reserve.

mitii.tokenBudget.outputMaxTokens.description: Ceiling for the derived output reserve.

mitii.tokenBudget.outputWindowCapRatio.description: Output cannot exceed this fraction of the advertised window.

mitii.tokenBudget.toolSchemaFallbackToke.description: Fallback tool-JSON tokens when tool schemas have not been measured.

mitii.tokenBudget.toolSchemaFallbackWind.description: Fallback tool cost cannot exceed this fraction of the window.

mitii.tokenBudget.minimumUsableInputToke.description: Keep at least this many tokens for prompt and history after output and tools.

mitii.tokenBudget.loopSafetyRatio.description: Fraction of usable input allowed in the live model-loop budget.

mitii.tokenBudget.repositoryShare.description: Share of usable input for repository context.

mitii.tokenBudget.conversationShare.description: Share of usable input for conversation and tool history.

mitii.tokenBudget.planShare.description: Share of usable input for plan text.

mitii.tokenBudget.skillsShare.description: Share of usable input for selected skill bodies.

mitii.tokenBudget.planTokensCap.description: Hard cap on plan tokens regardless of share.

mitii.tokenBudget.skillsTokensCap.description: Hard cap on skill-body tokens regardless of share.

mitii.tokenBudget.repositoryTokensCap.description: Hard cap on repository-context tokens regardless of share.

mitii.tokenBudget.compactionWarnRatio.description: Loop pressure warning fires at this fraction of the loop budget.

mitii.tokenBudget.compactionAutoRatio.description: Automatic history compaction starts at this fraction of the loop budget.

mitii.tokenBudget.compactionHardRatio.description: Aggressive compaction and memory reinject at this fraction of the loop budget.

mitii.tokenBudget.keepRecentToolResultsB.description: Minimum number of recent tool results kept in full.

mitii.tokenBudget.keepRecentToolResultsP.description: Add one kept tool result per this many usable-input tokens.

mitii.tokenBudget.keepRecentToolResultsM.description: Maximum number of recent tool results kept in full.

mitii.tokenBudget.compactedToolResultCha.description: Minimum characters retained for compacted tool results.
Add one retained character per this many usable-input tokens.
Maximum characters retained for compacted tool results.

mitii.tokenBudget.filesPerOutputTokens.description: Unique files per mutation call scale as output / this value.

mitii.tokenBudget.minUniqueFilesPerCall.description: Floor for files allowed in one mutation call.

mitii.tokenBudget.maxUniqueFilesPerCallC.description: Ceiling for files allowed in one mutation call.

mitii.tokenBudget.patchPayloadOutputRati.description: Fraction of output tokens treated as patch payload capacity.

mitii.tokenBudget.charsPerOutputToken.description: Approximate characters produced per output token for payload sizing.

mitii.tokenBudget.requireBatchedBelowOut.description: Force batched mutation when derived output is below this many tokens.

mitii.tokenBudget.visiblePlanMinUsableTo.description: Visible plans are skipped when usable input is below this.

mitii.tokenBudget.changeImpactMinUsableT.description: Change-impact analysis is skipped when usable input is below this.

mitii.tokenBudget.diagnosticStepsBase.description: Minimum diagnostic change steps in a drafted plan.

mitii.tokenBudget.diagnosticStepsPerUsab.description: Add one diagnostic step per this many usable-input tokens.

mitii.tokenBudget.maxModelCallsPerUsable.description: Suggested model-call cap scales as usable input / this value.

mitii.tokenBudget.maxModelCallsMin.description: Floor for the window-derived model-call cap.

mitii.tokenBudget.maxModelCallsMax.description: Ceiling for the window-derived model-call cap when Modes run budget is limited.

mitii.tokenBudget.maxSkillsBase.description: Minimum number of skills that may be selected.

mitii.tokenBudget.maxSkillsPerUsable.description: Add one selectable skill per this many usable-input tokens.

mitii.tokenBudget.verificationChecksPerU.description: Add one verification check per this many usable-input tokens.

mitii.provider.type.description: LLM provider adapter: echo, OpenAI-compatible (/v1), Anthropic Messages (Claude), or Gemini.

mitii.provider.preset.description: Provider preset that prefills base URL, model, and adapter. Use openai-compatible for any /v1 chat completions API.

mitii.provider.baseUrl.description: Provider API base URL (OpenAI-compatible /v1, https://api.anthropic.com, or https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com).

mitii.provider.model.description: Model id (for example gpt-4o-mini, claude-sonnet-4-5, gemini-2.5-flash, deepseek-chat).

mitii.provider.contextWindow.description: Model context window in tokens. Set 0 to use the model preset; use a positive value only when your runtime has a different limit.

mitii.provider.maximumOutputTokens.description: Maximum tokens the model may generate per call. Set 0 to derive the reserve from the context window via Window Budget (mitii.tokenBudget.*). A positive value is a hard host override.

mitii.semanticIndex.enabled.description: Enable semantic workspace indexing. Bundled MiniLM works with any chat provider. HTTP embedding sources fail closed to lexical indexing if the probe fails.

mitii.semanticIndex.source.description: Embedding source for semantic indexing. Bundled runs on-device MiniLM (native ONNX, WASM fallback). Ollama and OpenAI-compatible call an HTTP embeddings API. Disabled keeps lexical indexing only. LanceDB is the vector store, not a source.

mitii.semanticIndex.backend.markdownDeprecationMessage: Use `mitii.semanticIndex.source` instead. `auto` now selects bundled MiniLM unless an embedding model is configured.
mitii.semanticIndex.backend.description: Deprecated alias for mitii.semanticIndex.source. Auto selects bundled MiniLM when no embedding model is set.

mitii.semanticIndex.model.description: Embedding model used for HTTP embedding sources. Ignored for bundled MiniLM. Empty uses the source preset, such as nomic-embed-text for Ollama.

mitii.semanticIndex.dimensions.description: Embedding vector dimensions for the semantic workspace index. Set 0 to use the backend preset/probe result. Changing this creates a distinct vector profile.

mitii.semanticIndex.normalized.description: Normalize embedding vectors before storing and querying the semantic workspace index. Changing this creates a distinct vector profile.

mitii.workspace.rootPathOverride.description: Optional workspace root override used for indexing and agent runs

mitii.skills.workspace.enabled.description: Load workspace-uploaded skills from .mitii/skills. Disable to run with only bundled/default skills.

mitii.ui.showReasoning.description: Show live reasoning / thinking activity in the Mitii chat UI

mitii.ui.reasoningPreviewMaxChars.description: Maximum characters retained in the reasoning preview stream

mitii.ui.depth.description: Default planning depth hint for chat turns

mitii.ui.modeDefaults.ask.approvalMode.description: Default approval mode for Ask mode

mitii.ui.modeDefaults.ask.model.description: Default model for Ask mode. Empty uses the active provider model.

mitii.ui.modeDefaults.plan.approvalMode.description: Default approval mode for Plan mode

mitii.ui.modeDefaults.plan.model.description: Default model for Plan mode. Empty uses the active provider model.

mitii.ui.modeDefaults.agent.approvalMode.description: Default approval mode for Agent mode

mitii.ui.modeDefaults.agent.model.description: Default model for Agent mode. Empty uses the active provider model.

mitii.agent.taskListAutoAdvance.description: Product default ON: after a successful built-in mutating tool in Agent mode, mark the active checklist item done and activate the next pending item (at most once per model turn). The SDK/engine library default remains off when hosts do not pass taskListAutoAdvance.

mitii.ui.contextToggles.repoMap.description: Include repository map hints in agent context

mitii.ui.contextToggles.diagnostics.description: Include Problems diagnostics in agent context

mitii.ui.contextToggles.gitDiff.description: Include git status/diff hints in agent context

mitii.ui.contextToggles.editor.description: Auto-include the active editor in agent context

mitii.ui.contextToggles.openTabs.description: Include open editor tab paths in agent context

mitii.scm.commitMessageStyle.description: Style hint for generated commit messages

mitii.safety.approvalMode.description: Approval autonomy: safe (ask before mutations), guided (approve tool use automatically), pilot (full access including plan approval). Legacy builder maps to guided.

mitii.runBudget.unlimited.description: Disable practical per-run model/tool/loop/wall-time caps for long-running local work. Provider quotas and machine limits still apply.

mitii.runBudget.maxModelCalls.description: Maximum model calls allowed in one Mitii run before it stops with budget_exhausted.

mitii.runBudget.maxToolCalls.description: Maximum tool calls allowed in one Mitii run before it stops with budget_exhausted.

mitii.runBudget.maxLoopIterations.description: Maximum model/tool loop iterations allowed in one Mitii run before it stops with budget_exhausted.

mitii.runBudget.maxWallTimeMinutes.description: Maximum active wall-clock minutes allowed in one Mitii run. Time waiting for user approval is excluded by the engine.

mitii.onboarding.completed.description: Whether first-run onboarding has been completed for this workspace

mitii.mcp.description: MCP store install list (mirrored to .mitii/mcp.json). Off by default; add servers from the Settings store or as custom stdio/SSE entries. Deleting removes them from the install list.

enabled.description: Master switch for all installed MCP servers

servers.description: Installed MCP servers (empty until added from the store)

id.description: Stable server id (builtins: filesystem, sequential-thinking, memory, puppeteer)

enabled.description: Per-server on/off within the install list
